targetVolumeCoordinatesHelp: Target Volume Coordinates are initialized when components are added. Minimum and maximum values for X, Y, and Z can be specified or edited.
volumeBoundaryHelp: The Contains Only volume search condition causes only items fully contained by the volume to be returned. Intersecting causes any items contained by, or Intersecting with, the volume to be returned. Returned items are either added to the selection state, or made visible, according the Action setting.
volumeActionHelp: Select causes any visible items satisfying the volume search conditions to be added to the selection state. Hidden items are not considered. Show Only makes any parts in the structure that satisfy the volume conditions visible.
flipDesc: Double click axes to reverse the direction of the moved part. Drag axes to move the part.
